nodes.label: Writes take one exclusive lock
nodes.note: A single advisory file lock guards every write; readers never block.

nodes.label: The graph file is replaced atomically
nodes.note: Write to a temp file, fsync, then os.replace so a reader sees old or new, never a half-written graph.

nodes.label: No background daemon
nodes.note: Expiry is an explicit command that a cron job can call; the library never starts a thread.

nodes.label: Storage is plain JSON
nodes.note: Human readable, diffable in git, no database engine involved.

nodes.label: Zero runtime dependencies
nodes.note: Only the Python standard library is imported at runtime.

nodes.label: Ranking is two-key
nodes.note: Nodes carrying evidence come before unanchored ones at the same score.

nodes.label: The MCP server can be started read-only
nodes.note: Write tools are refused before dispatch and the store refuses every commit.

nodes.label: Add an expire command
nodes.note: Dry run by default; --apply supersedes expired nodes.

nodes.label: Log high-risk reads
nodes.note: Query text is appended to reads.jsonl, rotated at one megabyte.

nodes.label: Support Windows file locking
nodes.note: msvcrt byte-range lock replaces fcntl on Windows.

nodes.label: Bound the digest output
nodes.note: The digest honours a byte budget and prints how many lines were truncated.

nodes.label: Bulk import is all or nothing
nodes.note: One invalid record rolls back the whole batch; no partial writes.

nodes.label: Evaluating vector retrieval
nodes.note: A labelled query set must exist before any embedding experiment is accepted.

nodes.label: Cold archive of old nodes
nodes.note: Nodes untouched for thirty days move to an archive file, still audited.

nodes.label: retrieval.py
nodes.note: Substring scoring with field weights; superseded nodes are filtered before scoring.

nodes.label: store.py
nodes.note: Locking and the atomic replace live here.

nodes.label: mcp.py
nodes.note: Newline delimited JSON-RPC over stdin and stdout; eight tools, no socket.

nodes.label: Two writers lost an update
nodes.note: Concurrent writers overwrote each other before the lock existed.

nodes.label: Chinese queries recall poorly
nodes.note: The tokenizer falls back to single characters; long phrases miss.

nodes.label: Digest could grow without limit
nodes.note: A large graph produced a summary longer than the context it was meant to fit.

nodes.label: Lock waits blocked the CLI
nodes.note: A one second timeout now exits with code three instead of hanging.

nodes.label: Never invent an evidence hash
nodes.note: If the original bytes are gone, record the gap; do not synthesise a digest.

nodes.label: Docs must match code
nodes.note: A CI gate fails when a documented symbol does not exist.

nodes.label: History is append-only
nodes.note: Change records are never edited or deleted; mistakes are corrected by new events.

nodes.label: Python 3.10 or newer
nodes.note: Dataclasses and match statements are used freely.

nodes.label: Embedding model candidate
nodes.note: A sentence encoder would add a download and a dependency, so it stays out until measured.

nodes.label: Does semantic similarity beat keyword matching here?
nodes.note: Users paraphrase; the current scorer only matches literal substrings.
